name: WESAD: Wearable Stress and Affect Detection
description: WESAD is a publicly available multimodal dataset for wearable stress and affect detection. It includes physiological signals from 15 subjects during a controlled laboratory protocol with baseline, stress (Trier Social Stress Test), and amusement conditions recorded using both chest-worn (RespiBAN) and wrist-worn (Empatica E4) sensors.
